basic_details.job_title: GSPCB Multi-tasking Staff Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Goa State Pollution Control Board (GSPCB) has advertised 2 Multi-tasking Staff posts at pay Level 1 under Advertisement No. 1/2026. Candidates need a Secondary School certificate or an Industrial Training Institute course, knowledge of Konkani and a 15 years residence certificate. The maximum age is 45. Applications are open from 11 November 2026 to 30 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age is 45 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted from 11 November 2026 to 30 November 2026. The notice does not describe the application method.
Secondary School certificate, or Industrial Training Institute course certificate.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 2 posts of Multi-tasking Staff in total. The notice adds that, out of the 2 posts, 1 post is reserved for Ex-Servicemen.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Passed Secondary School certificate / examination from a recognized Board / Institution, OR passed course conducted by Industrial Training Institute or equivalent trade from recognized Institution. Knowledge of Konkani. 15 years residence certificate. The notice says a course conducted by an Industrial Training Institute, or equivalent qualifications in a relevant trade, may be considered in case the post relates to technical work. Knowledge of Marathi. Multi-tasking skills such as knowledge of operating office machines including computers. The maximum age is 45 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Scale of Pay for Multi-tasking Staff is Level 1. The notice does not state the pay amount, allowances or the nature of the appointment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSPCB Multi-tasking Staff
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted from 11 November 2026 to 30 November 2026. The notice does not describe the application method. Secondary School certificate, or Industrial Training Institute course certificate. 15 years residence certificate.

faq.question: Q1. How many Multi-tasking Staff posts are there in GSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 reserved for General and 1 for OBC (Non Creamy layer). Out of the 2 posts, 1 post is reserved for Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GSPCB Multi-tasking Staff?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When did applications start?
faq.answer: The start date of application is 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for GSPCB Multi-tasking Staff?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Secondary School certificate / examination from a recognized Board / Institution, or a course conducted by an Industrial Training Institute or equivalent trade from a recognized Institution. Knowledge of Konkani is also essential.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GSPCB Multi-tasking Staff?
Q6. What is the pay for GSPCB Multi-tasking Staff?
faq.answer: The Scale of Pay is Level 1.

faq.question: Q7. Is a residence certificate required?
faq.answer: Yes. A 15 years residence certificate is listed as an essential requirement.

faq.question: Q8. Is knowledge of Marathi compulsory?
faq.answer: No. Knowledge of Marathi is listed as desirable, as are multi-tasking skills such as operating office machines including computers. Knowledge of Konkani is essential.
